description.zh: 背景素材的点播资源id，从点播控制台获取
description.en: VOD resource ID of the background material, obtained from the VOD console.
Resource access URL of the background material.

description.zh:
背景素材类型：
- VOD 点播视频
- PIC 图片
- LIVE 直播流
description.en:
Background material type:
- VOD: Video on demand
- PIC: Image
- LIVE: Live stream

description.zh:
预览画面高度，单位：px

预览画面宽度x高度仅支持以下规格：

- 横屏流畅 360P 640x360
- 竖屏流畅 360P 360x640
- 横屏标清 480P 854x480
- 竖屏标清 480P 480x854
- 横屏高清 720P 1280x720
- 竖屏高清 720P 720x1280
- 横屏超清 1080P 1920x1080
- 竖屏超清 1080P 1080x1920
description.en:
Preview screen height, unit: px.

The preview screen width x height only supports the following specifications:

- Landscape Smooth 360P 640x360
- Portrait Smooth 360P 360x640
- Landscape Standard Definition 480P 854x480
- Portrait Standard Definition 480P 480x854
- Landscape HD 720P 1280x720
- Portrait HD 720P 720x1280
- Landscape Full HD 1080P 1920x1080
- Portrait Full HD 1080P 1080x1920

description.zh: 源流抠图后的布局位置信息
description.en: Layout position information of the source stream after matting.

description.zh:
抠图类型：
- green 绿幕抠图
- blue 蓝幕抠图
- complex 实景抠图
description.en:
Matting type:
- green: Green screen matting
- blue: Blue screen matting
- complex: Real-scene matting

description.zh: 多媒体素材的位置布局信息
description.en: Layout position information of the multimedia material.

description.zh: 多媒体素材的点播资源id，从点播控制台获取
description.en: VOD resource ID of the multimedia material, obtained from the VOD console.

description.zh: 多媒体素材的资源访问url，与资源id二选一传入
description.en: Resource access URL of the multimedia material. Either this or the resource ID should be provided.

description.zh:
多媒体素材类型：
- VOD 点播视频
- PIC 图片
- LIVE 直播流
description.en:
Multimedia material type:
- VOD: Video on demand
- PIC: Image
- LIVE: Live stream

description.zh: 虚拟演播模板名称，与创建接口中的入参StudioName相同
description.en: Virtual studio template name, same as the StudioName parameter in the create API.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live modify-live-ai-studio --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --studio-name stu02 --description custom --width 1920 --height 1080 --background-type VOD --background-resource-id d0eb493192c771efba644531858c0102 --background-resource-url https://xxx.com/2.mp4 --media-type VOD --media-resource-id d0eb493192c771efba644531858c01102 --media-resource-url https://xxx.com/1.mp4 --media-layout PositionY=0.0 HeightNormalized=0.5 PositionX=0.0 --matting-type complex --matting-layout PositionY=0.0 HeightNormalized=0.5 PositionX=0.0 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live ModifyLiveAIStudio --region cn-hangzhou --MediaResourceId d0eb493192c771efba644531858c01102 --MediaResourceUrl 'https://xxx.com/1.mp4' --Description custom --MattingLayout '{"PositionY":0.0,"HeightNormalized":0.5,"PositionX":0.0}' --BackgroundResourceUrl 'https://xxx.com/2.mp4' --BackgroundType VOD --MattingType complex --MediaLayout '{"PositionY":0.0,"HeightNormalized":0.5,"PositionX":0.0}' --StudioName stu02 --MediaType VOD --Height 1080 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --BackgroundResourceId d0eb493192c771efba644531858c0102 --Width 1920
